answer: An extension is what someone adds to Silo. It can hold a back end, a front end and rules, each optional. Its declaration lists them, with what wakes the back end, the tools the back end may use and the secrets it needs.

sets.means: What someone adds to Silo: a back end, a front end and rules, each optional.
What an extension says of itself: its parts, what wakes its back end, the tools the back end may use and the secrets it needs. Its standard name is a manifest.
The part of an extension that is executed.
A view in the app, which an extension gives as data and the app draws.
